cases.name: Independiente 1
cases.coverageRationale: La regla 4.4 exige comprobación profesional antes de descartar grieta estructural; no hay método para diagnosticar esta grieta.
cases.question: I'm thinking of buying a fairly old flat, but there are cracks in some walls. How can I tell whether they are superficial or whether I'm getting into a serious problem?

cases.name: Independiente 2
cases.coverageRationale: Conservar elementos firmes y reformar selectivamente; cocina y posiciones de instalaciones. No se documenta un método de renovar frentes de muebles.
cases.question: The kitchen cabinets are fine. How can I refresh it without taking everything apart?

cases.name: Independiente 4
cases.coverageRationale: Investigar causa de humedad y drenaje/pendientes/encuentros permite orientación inicial limitada; no prescribe una solución de impermeabilización de terraza.
cases.question: When it rains heavily, my terrace leaks into the flat below. Where do I start?

cases.name: Independiente 7
cases.coverageRationale: Instalaciones envejecidas/incompatibles antes de cerrar paredes/suelos para no abrirlos otra vez. No es un cronograma completo.
cases.question: We've just bought a flat and want to renovate it before moving in. In what order should the work be done to avoid having to break things that are already finished?

cases.name: Independiente 3
cases.coverageRationale: El tabique acústico de oficina no responde al ruido de vecinos a través del techo ni a la pérdida de altura.
cases.question: In my home, we can hear absolutely everything the upstairs neighbours do. Can the sound insulation be improved without losing too much ceiling height in the rooms?

cases.name: Independiente 5
cases.coverageRationale: Se mencionan ventanas deficientes, sin comparación doble/triple ni criterios térmicos de selección.
cases.question: I want to replace my home's windows, but I don't know whether triple glazing is really worthwhile or whether double glazing is enough.

cases.name: Independiente 6
cases.coverageRationale: Pasillo estrecho trata transporte y ejecución de solera, no diseño para iluminación o aprovechamiento del espacio.
cases.question: I have a long, dark corridor. How can I get more light and make better use of the space?

cases.name: Independiente 8
cases.coverageRationale: Vigas de madera aborda secado/encuentros, sin criterios estructurales para reforzar o sustituir una viga combada.
cases.question: The wooden beams in my old house are bowed. Can they be reinforced or do they need replacing?

cases.name: Independiente 9
cases.coverageRationale: Revisar climatización existente no demuestra que el desequilibrio térmico se pueda solucionar sin sustituir el sistema.
cases.question: Our office is very hot in some areas and cold in others. Can this be solved by renovating the climate-control installation without replacing the whole system?

cases.name: Independiente 10
cases.coverageRationale: Existe filtro general de cambio de uso/licencia/técnico; no catálogo de obras de apertura de una cafetería. Cocina doméstica no equivale a local de hostelería.

cases.name: Broken kitchen pipes
cases.coverageRationale: R4R_80 and FAQ-053 prioritise safety, safe supply shut-off and professional repair, with watertightness and drying checks before closing up; a complete renovation is not required.
cases.question: I have broken pipes in my kitchen. What should I do?

cases.name: Kitchen leak and renovation
cases.coverageRationale: R4R_80 separates essential repairs from optional renovation, plans water and drainage before finishes, retains viable elements and prices work separately.
cases.question:
I have broken pipes in my kitchen. What should I do?
I also want to renovate my kitchen. What do you recommend?

cases.name: Kitchen leak, renovation and tiles
cases.coverageRationale: R4R_80 addresses all three questions: control the leak, define optional renovation and replace tiles after repair on a sound, dry substrate, with separate work items.
cases.question:
I have broken pipes in my kitchen. What should I do?
I also want to renovate my kitchen. What do you recommend?
Can I replace the tiles too?

cases.name: Leaking pool and loose tiles
cases.coverageRationale: R4R_89 X-01 and R4R_113 distinguish surface repair from diagnosing shell, joint or pipe leaks; inspect substrate, adhesion and waterproofing before replacing tiles, without claiming an R4R service.
cases.question: My swimming pool is losing water and some tiles are coming loose. Is reattaching them enough?

cases.name: Public changing rooms and phased work
cases.coverageRationale: R4R_89 and R4R_113 cover public use, ventilation, water, drainage, slip resistance, accessibility, escape routes, permits and phases compatible with users, hygiene and safety; they do not establish an R4R service.
cases.question: I want to renovate changing rooms in a sports centre that remains open. What should I check to carry out the work in phases?
